content: You will be given an argumentation and asked about to find the relation from relation types: sup (support), exa (support by example), add (additional source), reb (rebutting attack), und (undercutting attack), joint (joining relation) between two selected argument components from it.

Although the workload is getting heavier in many professions and physical and psychological wear on personnel is steadily increasing, the statutory retirement age should in the future not remain at 63 years. For, due to the low birth rate, the proportion of the elderly population and with it pension costs are on the rise, and furthermore, due to today's healthcare most people in many occupations are fitter for work in old age than before.
What is the relation between "For, due to the low birth rate, the proportion of the elderly population and with it pension costs are on the rise," and "the statutory retirement age should in the future not remain at 63 years." from the above essay? Choose from following options  1. reb
2. und
3. joint
4. exa
5. sup
6. no relation
